lemmas.statement_nl: Let [n]_q=(1-q^n)/(1-q), let Phi_n(q) be the nth cyclotomic polynomial, let M_n(q):=[n]_q Phi_n(q)^2, and let Loc_{M_n} be the localization of Q[q,q^{-1}] obtained by inverting every polynomial V(q) in Q[q] with gcd(V(q),M_n(q))=1. Let Y(q)=A(q)/B(q) be a rational function with A(q) in Q[q,q^{-1}] and B(q) in Q[q], and assume gcd(B(q),M_n(q))=1. If for every primitive nth root of unity zeta we have Y(zeta)=0 and Y'(zeta)=0, where derivative is with respect to q, then there exists K(q) in Loc_{M_n} such that Y(q)=Phi_n(q)^2 K(q) in Q(q). Equivalently, Y(q) ≡ 0 mod Phi_n(q)^2 in the localized sense.
